Name: Desert Obelisk - Japanese Style
Author: CirrusMoth
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3947][b][u]Seasonal Japanese Buildings[/u][/b][/url] is one of my favorite mods, but sadly, it was never updated to include the Desert Obelisk. So here is my version. It is meant to fit right in with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52012881]sonreirblah[/url]'s Earth & Water Obelisks. 

[u][b]Simple to install[/b][/u]:
Just drop the images into the Assets folder for [b]Seasonal Japanese Buildings[/b] .

You also need to add the code into the [b]content.json [/b]file for the mod to include the overwrite instructions for the Desert Obelisk.
Put the code below in with the ones for the Earth & Water ones and you're all set.

[size=3] ﻿ ﻿[i]{
    "Action": "Load",
    "Target": "Buildings/Desert Obelisk",
    "FromFile": "assets/Desert Obelisk_{{season}}.png",
    },[/i][i]
 [/i][/size]

(Obviously requires the original mod above) 


This is my first public mod, so please be kind. 
All credit due to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52012881]sonreirblah[/url] for their awesome mod. :)

Downloads.Description: File folder with images. Drag and drop into Seasonal Japanese Buildings asset folder.
